task.description: Independently re-verify REQ-258's marker insertion across 8 docs/migration/decisions/*.md files.

result.note: All 6 independent checks pass, matching DOC-UPDATER's claims exactly. (1) `git diff 0e2f2a8b..HEAD --stat`: exactly the 8 target files plus the step-02-doc-updater.json handoff file changed, 73 insertions/0 deletions, no other file touched. (2) Per-file `.zig` count unchanged before vs after (git show 0e2f2a8b:<path> vs working tree): 0001=19, 0002=16, 0003=2, 0007=2, 0010=13, 0013=3, 0014=13, 0016=7 (all identical before/after) -- zero citation text lost. (3) Marker counts per file, independently grepped: 0001=11, 0002=7, 0003=2, 0007=2, 0010=5, 0013=2, 0014=9, 0016=5, total=43, matching the claimed 43 exactly. (4) `git diff` restricted to each of the 8 files shows every changed line is a pure `+PROVENANCE (historical, not current decision authority):` addition -- no deletions, no modification of any existing line, in any file. (5) Divergence-note check (`grep -rnE 'unlike R-Co|deliberately diverges|diverges from R-Co'`) against 0e2f2a8b vs HEAD: identical single match in 0007-variable-merge-validates-new-keys.md, text byte-identical, line number shifted 66->68 (expected, from the 2 markers inserted earlier in that same file). (6) `git diff --stat` against CLAUDE.md, README.md, docs/migration/README.md is empty -- confirmed untouched. Placement spot-check: 0001's 7 numbered-list bullets (trace.zig..rate_limit.zig) are each individually marked immediately above the specific bullet, never merged across siblings; 0001's two fenced code blocks (route/middleware filename listings) are each marked once above the block, not per line; 0010's fenced code block (file-size listing) likewise gets one marker above the block; 0014's and 0016's markers each sit directly above their own paragraph/bullet citation unit with no gaps or orphaned unmarked .zig references found in either file. All placements conform to the design doc's smallest-enclosing-unit rule (line/paragraph/code-block, one marker per unit, never per-line inside a block). No idiom/OTP/supervision concerns apply -- this is a pure documentation-marking task with no code changes. No scope creep observed; work matches REQ-258's stated 239e1 chunk exactly, with the five sibling chunks (239e2, 239f-i, 239a-d) correctly left untouched.
